description: Cover areas of a video, each for a stretch of time. Takes video files. Needs FFmpeg.

TimedArea.description: An area of the picture for a stretch of time.

to.description: To, in seconds; the end when left out.

x.description: Left edge, in pixels from the left.

y.description: Top edge, in pixels from the top.

areas.description: The areas to cover, each with its stretch of time.

blur.description: Blur the areas instead of filling them with `color`.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

name: video_redact
title: Redact
